description:
Update an existing custom organization field.

Note: `field_type` cannot be changed. For `enum`/`set` fields, `options` is the **full set** of options after update — include each existing option's `id` to preserve it, or omit `id` to add a new option.

Common use cases:
- Rename a field
- Add/remove options on an enum dropdown
- Toggle the field's visibility in the add form

add_visible_flag.description: Whether the field is shown in the "add" form by default

id.description: ID of the organization field to update

name.description: New display name of the field

options.description: New full set of options. Include existing `id` to preserve, omit it to add.

name: fields_update_organization_field
